summary: Unlimited Technology Systems LLC, a Montgomery, Ohio-based revenue cycle management company, identified unauthorized activity in its commercial data center on October 19, 2025. An external third party may have obtained copies of files between October 5-10, 2025. Exposed data included patient names, addresses, email, phone, dates of birth, health insurance information, patient balances, Social Security numbers, medical diagnoses, and scanned government ID documents. Affected individuals were offered 24 months of complimentary credit monitoring and UTS implemented enhanced security measures.
